verdict.rationale: smolagents lets you push agents and tools to the Hub as Space repositories and load them back with from_hub, which gives a stored, shareable artifact. agent.replay() and OpenTelemetry instrumentation support reviewing what a run did, but that is review of executions, not of automation definitions. Nothing documents version history, diffing, or rolling back to a prior version. Missing for 10: explicit versioning/revision history of agents, review or diff workflow for automation changes, rollback to a prior version, independent corroboration.
